evidence.description: An Audi SUV was reported stolen by an owner who was on vacation, along with credit cards that were later used fraudulently

notes: Reported days after the Medina incident in November 2024; only the month is known. The article does not say a home burglary took place. The scene is typed as vehicle for that reason. The series is described in KIRO 7 as burglaries between November 2024 and February 2025 across Seattle, Medina, Sammamish and Everett.
